A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. Their text, equations, tables, figures and appendices support reliable comparison after matching relocated and renumbered material.

before.justification: V6 reports original Atari and continuous-control experiments, including regularization ablations, C51/IQN comparisons and the appendix DERAC experiments.

after.justification: V7 retains original Atari and continuous-control learning curves, including regularization sweeps, entropy-interaction comparisons and bin-size ablations.

M1.justification: V7 removes the practical DERAC algorithm from v6 Appendix J, including its interpolated critic loss, augmented policy objective and Algorithm 2. The return-density decomposition and tabular DERPI procedure remain.

E1.justification: The Atari and continuous-control task coverage is retained, including the appendix cross-entropy comparisons. Every environment used in the deleted DERAC experiments remains evaluated elsewhere.

E2.justification: Deleting v6 Appendix J removes the DERAC comparisons against AC and DAC (C51) in Figures 6–7. Comparator membership within the retained experiments is unchanged; the newly cited works are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: The DERAC-specific evaluation configurations disappear, including its lambda/epsilon sensitivity grid and five-environment comparison. Table 1, training budgets and settings for the retained experiments remain unchanged.

E4.justification: V7 removes Appendix J.4–J.5, which tested whether DERAC mitigates excessive exploration and whether its behavior persists across lambda/epsilon settings. The other regularization sweeps, entropy-interaction analyses, cross-entropy checks and bin-size ablations remain.

E5.justification: The new checklist explicitly identifies shading in all learning curves as standard deviation; v6 explicitly defined this only in the Atari captions for Figures 3 and 10. Retained seed counts remain three for Atari and five for continuous-control comparisons, with no reported increase in runs.

E6.justification: All DERAC results in v6 Figures 6–7 disappear, including its reported superiority over AC and DAC (C51) on BipedalWalkerHardcore and its sensitivity findings. The retained curves and Table 1 values are unchanged; the C51/IQN figure exchange does not establish new results.

T1.justification: V7 adds an explicit unit-mass argument to the Proposition 1 proof in Appendix D and removes the auxiliary heuristic DERAC interpolation derivation from v6 Appendix J.2. The main propositions, convergence theorems and quantile-loss derivations are retained.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the central claims about categorical-loss decomposition, uncertainty-aware exploration and its relationship to MaxEnt regularization. The revised policy-gradient wording describes the existing actor-critic extension; v6 presented DERAC as a secondary byproduct.

C2.justification: New Appendix C explains the use of evolving transition data and explicitly excludes a Neural FZI convergence proof for that setting. V7 also removes the DERAC-specific interpretation that interpolation can mitigate over-exploration. The central exploration interpretation and quantile-extension limitation remain.

D1.justification: The new checklist discloses multiple RTX 3090 GPUs and a plan to release code upon acceptance, without establishing actual availability. DERAC-specific implementation details disappear, while the RLKit description and shared hyperparameter table remain.

R1.justification: V7 adds references to Ishfaq et al. on Langevin soft actor-critic and Kastner et al. on KL-based categorical distributional RL. It removes Shi et al., previously used in the DERAC derivation. The broader research positioning remains stable.

P1.justification: The eight-section main narrative and most prose remain. V7 makes local wording, notation and affiliation edits, adds acknowledgements, a checklist and appendix contents, and reorganizes the appendix and discussion accompanying the relocated experiments.

P2.justification: The main text changes from two columns to a single-column NeurIPS layout, with extensive reflow of equations and displays. C51 results move into Figure 4 with panels grouped by outcome, IQN results move to appendix Figure 7, and the DERAC algorithm display and two figures disappear.

improvement.justification: V7 improves precision through the Neural FZI scope clarification and expanded normalization argument, and foregrounds the relevant C51 evidence. However, it removes the concrete DERAC construction and its experimental and sensitivity support. With the central claims otherwise retained, the balance between clearer focus and reduced practical support has no reliably clear net direction.
